descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
CLICK CLACK MIXED REALITY

A mixed reality FPS played in your actual home. Your walls, your doors, your hallways. Realistic firearms with full manual handling. Digital blood on your real walls. No mercy.

ARSENAL. Pistol, AR and shotgun, all handled by hand: seated mags, charging handles, a pump you work yourself, dual wielding. Fit lights, lasers, suppressors and holo sights. And, for the first time in mixed reality, variable-zoom sniper scopes that look through the headset's live passthrough camera, with night vision and thermal. Plus frag grenades.

EIGHT MODES. Breach: enemies cross your yard by armoured car and helicopter, blow open your walls and drop through your roof. Hostage Rescue, Shoot Out, The List, Bomb Defusal, Target Practice, Guess Who and Duck Hunt.

SMART ENEMIES hear your gunfire, vault couches, flank and keep you in sight. Imposters hide among the hostages. Pick a UAV drone with a wrist minimap or a HUD visor with heat and night vision.

BREACHABLE DOORS with real hinges, latches and bulletproof glass.

PLAY TOGETHER. Every mode in local co-op, same room, your own Wi-Fi, no servers. Or RED v BLUE deathmatch, 1v1 to 4v4.

YOUR SPACE, YOUR MAP. Play in your room scan, or build your whole multi-story house in the Map Builder, with stairs enemies use, windows, doorways and glass that shatters. Twelve save slots. Add FIRE, QUAKE, STORM and NIGHT variants. They stack.

No teleport. You move by moving. Quest 3, 3S, Pro and 2. Scopes need Quest 3 or 3S.
